game_concept: A strategy race set in The Kingdom – Watchtower Ring, towers along the town wall: the herald must handle bandits while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Uninitialized Hunt: Find variables used before assignment and fix them before bandits exploit the gap.
theme: The Kingdom – Watchtower Ring: towers along the town wall
core_gameplay_loop: In Watchtower Ring, repeat each round: Find variables used before assignment and fix them before bandits exploit the gap. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the herald ahead. Then check the bugs_fixed value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the town gate by solving code steps involving bugs_fixed that move the herald forward.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.95).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the town gate first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 4 (applied tier): Uninitialized Hunt
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Uninitialized Hunt' (Week 1 slot 15), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Watchtower Ring'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how bugs_fixed changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against bandits in Watchtower Ring.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.95).
